newsitem.title: USA: Axsys sells unit, to amend 10Q filings.
newsitem.headline: Axsys sells unit, to amend 10Q filings.

text.p: Axsys Technologies Inc said Thursday it had sold its L&S Machine Co Inc unit to Tru-Circle Manufacturing Inc for about $13.3 million, subject to post-closing adjustment.
The purchase price includes the assumption to about $1.8 million in long-term capitalized leases, Axsys said.
Axsys plans to amend its Form 10Q filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the periods ended June 30 and September 30 to report L&S as an asset held for sale as of April 26, it said.
Accordingly, no gain will be recorded in connection with the sale of L&S.
Axsys said cash proceeds of about $11.5 million from the unit sale have been used to pre-pay debt under the company's bank credit agreement.

After giving effect to the amendment, earnings per share for the quarter and nine month periods ended September 30 will be $0.14 and $0.38, respectively. It had reported EPS of $0.08 and $0.28 before the amendment.
